The departments that help the president design and carry out foreign policy are best answered as **the State Department**, the lead department of the foreign policy bureaucracy. The shared note also accepts the National Security Council, and my earlier answer used the broader label "foreign policy bureaucracy," which doesn't name either one. I'm less sure of this than my earlier 80, because the question's wording doesn't clearly settle between the two options.

CONFIDENCE: 50
